title: Add a default route via a gateway
summary: Configure your system to send all unknown traffic through a specific gateway IP address. This is typically used when setting up a static network configuration or fixing routing issues.

steps.explain: Add a default route that directs all traffic not matching other routes to the specified gateway IP.
steps.cmd: sudo ip route add default via <GATEWAY_IP>

placeholders.name: GATEWAY_IP
placeholders.description: The IP address of your gateway/router

rollback.explain: Delete the default route to revert to the previous configuration.

warnings: Incorrect gateway settings can disconnect you from the network.
Ensure the gateway IP is reachable on your local network.
